verified_facts.text: Located on 400 acres alongside Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve, near Torrey Pines and Carmel Valley.

verified_facts.text: Grounds include a grove of eucalyptus trees and a waterfall cascading through ancient volcanic rock.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers about two dozen weekly outdoor activities, including hiking, horseback trail rides, yoga, meditation and archery.

verified_facts.text: The resort has an 18-hole private golf course designed by Tom Fazio.
Amaya serves refined California-Mediterranean cuisine, casual poolside fare and inventive cocktails during happy hour.

verified_facts.text: The spa is a wellness facility of 21,000 square feet with massages, hydrotherapy, aromatherapy and restorative lounges.

verified_facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas have marble bathrooms, large balconies or terraces, and views of the gardens, the golf club or the canyon preserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: spacious marble bathrooms, expansive balconies or terraces, and spectacular views of the gardens, Grand Golf Club, or Canyon Preserve.

verified_facts.text: Villa Sorrento is a secluded one-story villa with three master bedrooms, each with a private bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: Secluded, spacious one story Villa with three master bedrooms with private bathroom each.

verified_facts.text: Larger suites and villas suit families or extended stays.

verified_facts.text: Guests are described as couples celebrating anniversaries, golf and spa enthusiasts, and families staying several days rather than making quick city stops.

verified_facts.text: The resort is not beachfront, though it is close to Del Mar's beaches, boutique shopping and surf breaks for light day trips.
verified_facts.excerpt: While not beachfront, the resort is close to Del Mar’s beautiful beaches, boutique shopping, and world-class surf breaks if you’re up for light day trips.

verified_facts.text: Torrey Pines State Reserve trails, Del Mar racetrack events and the One Paseo culinary district are nearby.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nearby, you can explore Torrey Pines State Reserve trails, Del Mar racetrack events, and the vibrant One Paseo culinary district.

verified_facts.text: Grand Social seasonal outdoor events with lawn games, live music and craft cocktails take place during the summer months.
